# Matthew Johnson | What You Say Next

> Matthew Johnson is a speaker, author, and public-sector executive, an Exactly What to Say® Certified Guide, and the author of the forthcoming book Effective Disagreement. He turns hard-earned public leadership experience into practical tools for navigating conflict, restoring trust, and moving complicated rooms toward a decision.

Matthew has spent more than twenty-five years leading through public meetings, competing priorities, institutional risk, and the moments when a room needs clarity more than another polished answer. He offers practical, story-driven sessions for government, associations, leadership teams, and organizations carrying high public trust.

## Keynote topics

- Effective Disagreement: How to tell the truth without burning the bridge, humiliating the other side, or losing sight of the mission.
- The Cost of Silence: Why thoughtful people go quiet, how authority drifts, and what leaders must interrupt before compliance replaces trust.
- Leading Under Pressure: A field-tested structure for protecting dignity, correcting misinformation, and moving difficult rooms toward a decision.

## Book

- [Effective Disagreement: How to Lead Through Conflict Without Losing Trust, Talent, or Purpose](https://whatyousaynext.com/#book): forthcoming. A practical guide to staying anchored to the truth, committed to the relationship, and loyal to the mission at the same time.
